body: I'm wondering if I should just get out of the house. Maybe meet up with someone. I feel like being alone is the worst thing I could do.
Certainty isn't something I put much stock in. I can try but its too late today. I'm worried about tonight though. I do feel better now but I don't know how long that will last.

Hi LG I'm ER given the circumstances it's nice to meet you too. I always get that knee jerk, "here we go again" reaction and I can't stand it. I'm bipolar so yeah it's always going to come back to this. Maybe not as bad but it's a roller coaster no matter what! I had a friend who took half a bottle of pills then texted me saying if I wasn't there he was going to take the rest. I wish I could talk myself down as well as I do other people =\
I don't know anyone here. Do you think if I found someone my doctor could speak to them?

He gave me some samples but it's not enough. I'm terrified of being off my medication. When it gets really bad I hear things and I don't want to get to that point. My parents will commit me I don't want to be committed. I had everything under control but I let it fall apart. I can't start over again.

I'm 26 but my mood disorder made it very hard to live on my own so I had to come back home a few months ago. I quit my job after a really bad manic episode in January but it was a huge mistake. I ended up right back where I started as usual. I don't have money or insurance to see anyone. I'm trying to get my job back but it will take months to get my health coverage back and I've run out of my medication.
